Installs a real chart (prometheus-pushgateway) into the k3s cluster via the
external helm-release install step, after waiting in-venue for the node to be
Ready. This is the check-helm-vm bed's install leg: the bed's own plan runs in
verify-only mode (mutating steps skipped) and fleet add lowers only CANDY
plans' run: steps, so the mutating install must live in a candy whose run:
steps execute during fleet add — never in the bed's own plan. The k3s-server
candy's node-ready check is a check: step that does not run during fleet add,
so this candy waits for the node itself (kubectl wait, no sleeps) before the
helm upgrade --install --wait can schedule the chart's pods.

## Acceptance plan

This candy's `plan:` — the runnable spec `charly check` executes against a live deployment. `check:` steps are idempotent probes; `run:` steps change state.

| Intent | Step |
|---|---|
| `run` | wait for the k3s node to be Ready in-venue — the k3s-server candy's node-ready check step does not run during fleet add, so this candy waits itself |
| `run` | install the prometheus-pushgateway chart via the external helm-release install step — the deploy-context run-step sugar (the helm-release word) lowers to the F3 external step-kind and Invokes the plugin's OpExecute over the E3b reverse channel IN-VENUE (helm upgrade --install against the guest's own k3s kubeconfig) |
| `check` | the prometheus-pushgateway release is deployed in the web namespace |
